title: Laptop
description: Dr. Emmy's laptop for the desk in her flat, Kenney Furniture Kit style (pale grey shell, darker keys), at the game's furniture scale. Rest pose shut. The lid hangs from `lid`, a pivot on the base's back top edge: rotation.x -1.85 opens it to a working angle, its screen facing the front (+Z). Static: the game swings the lid.
checks: 3/4 tile: a thin pale grey slab (the shut laptop), its lid sitting flat on the base with no gap or overlap
diag tile: the lid's pivot sits on the base's back top edge (-Z side)
LEFT tile: the base sits on the grid line, nothing floats
